name: Does AKN Design Group work on multi-unit rental properties, or only single-family homes?

mainEntity.name: Does AKN Design Group work on multi-unit rental properties, or only single-family homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group primarily focuses on substantial, customized renovations for individual residential units, whether they are single-family homes or individual units within a multi-family property. Our expertise lies in transforming interiors such as kitchens, bathrooms, or undertaking whole-home remodels for discerning property owners who value a managed design-build process and high-end craftsmanship. We assess each project on its scope and alignment with our specialization in significant residential transformations.
acceptedAnswer.description: We focus on substantial, customized renovations for individual residential units, including those within multi-family properties, prioritizing projects that align with our high-end design-build expertise.
